infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Remi uses your camera to help you capture visible symptoms or documents you choose to share.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Remi uses your microphone so you can speak your check-ins instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Remi uses Face ID to keep your health information private on this device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Remi uses your location to help find nearby pharmacies when a medication isn't available.
